item.title: 1000 Blank White Cards
item.description:
📝 Years active1996 to presentGenresParty game Card game NomicPlayersVariableSetup timeVariablePlaying timeVariableChanceVariableSkillsCartooning, Irony 1000 Blank White Cards is a party card game played with cards in which the deck is created as part of the game. Play[edit] The rules of game are determined as the game is played. Cards with no lasting effects, or cards that have been nullified, are placed in a discard pile.
